title: Spaceshunt Boots
summary: Casts Dimension Door once per Long Rest.

fields.Dimension Door: Level 4 Action. Teleport up to 165 ft to a point you can see. Bring one movable ally of Medium size or smaller within 7 ft, or select yourself to go alone. Forced-movement immunity prevents carrying an ally.
fields.Acquisition: Worn by Dolor, who moves to Facemaker’s Boutique if he survives the earlier encounter.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
